partners.heroText: A cohort of certified, screened, job-ready cybersecurity talent — available to interview this October.

stats.label: Vetted candidates in the inaugural cohort

partners.gapHeadline1: THERE ARE MORE OPEN CYBER ROLES THAN CREDENTIALED PEOPLE TO FILL THEM.
partners.gapHeadline2: WE'VE SCREENED THE TALENT TO CLOSE THE GAP.
partners.gapText: Beyond Code's Cybersecurity cohort is a pre-vetted pipeline of career-changers who hold stacked CompTIA industry credentials, have completed a live SOC-analyst simulation, and bring extensive work experience with transferable skills.
partners.gapStrong: You get first access to proven talent.
partners.whoText1: Every candidate enters your pipeline already holding a stack of CompTIA credentials, with all of them finishing Security+ certification by Q4 2026.
partners.whoText2: This isn't first-time talent. They're bringing real careers in systems administration, QA automation, IT leadership, and government audit as they transition into tech careers.
partners.proofText: Every graduate completes a SOC-analyst simulation — triaging real alerts in a SIEM lab, identifying the threat, and writing an incident report. It's the closest thing to an entry-level SOC workflow, and you can preview it before you interview.

pillars.title: STACKED CREDENTIALS
pillars.text: Tech+, Network+, and Security+ — industry-recognized proof that compounds, not a single bootcamp certificate.

pillars.title: HANDS-ON CAPSTONE
pillars.text: A completed SOC-analyst simulation demonstrates ability directly, even for candidates without prior security job history.

pillars.title: DURABLE SKILLS
pillars.text: Our career coaching curriculum builds the reliability, communication, and follow-through that make entry-level hires stick.

pillars.title: ONGOING SUPPORT
pillars.text: We stay engaged after the hire with wraparound support to protect retention.

partners.aboutText1: Beyond Code Collective is a nonprofit bridging the gap between inspiration, training, and employment in tech. We connect talent to accessible education, hands-on opportunities to build with emerging technologies, and clear pathways to launch and grow meaningful careers.
partners.aboutText2: Designed for participants of all ages and backgrounds, Beyond Code prepares people to thrive in a tech-powered world and achieve lasting career mobility. Catalyst is our flagship workforce program for adults — pairing market-relevant technical skills with durable mindset coaching, employer partnerships, and community.
partners.quoteText: Catalyst is how we ensure a human stays in the loop. We focus on building access to inspiration, to community, to early skills, enabling talent to build meaningful careers and become catalysts for change in the tech ecosystem.
partners.quoteAttribution: Cristina Mancini · Founder & CEO, Beyond Code Collective

atg.initiative: A BEYOND CODE COLLECTIVE ANCHOR PROGRAM
atg.description: Beyond The Game is a national, cohort-based workforce program for transitioning professional and NCAA student-athletes. It is explicitly designed for those who are not long-term earners and need structured support to design and enter a second career. This structured program bridges the “digital skill divide” with technical leaders teaching live classes and building curricula, and a community providing wraparound support that covers everything from corporate readiness to job placement.
atg.videoDescription: Hear directly from athletes who are building their next chapter through Beyond The Game. The transition doesn't have to be a solo journey.
atg.quoteText: I ask my guys to believe they can start over. I couldn't ask that if I hadn't done it myself — same classes, same exams, same late nights. The game taught me how to prepare; Kobie showed me what to prepare for.
atg.quoteRole: HEAD OF BEYOND THE GAME · TECH+ & NETWORK+ CERTIFIED
atg.problemText: Less than 2 percent of NCAA student-athletes go on to play professionally, and for those who do, the clock is already ticking. NFL careers last an average of 3–5 years; NBA careers, 4.5 years; and MLB, 5 years. When it comes to deciding what’s next, most athletes are left to figure it out alone.
atg.problemText2: This is not because they lack discipline, motivation or drive. What they lack is a bridge: the knowledge, context, and guidance to translate their skills into the next career they want.
programItems: Early, advisory coaching to clarify direction
A shared workforce and digital foundations core
atg.classroomText: Beyond The Game uses a “flipped-classroom” model using peer-based milestones and hands-on coding labs that respect the athlete’s learning style: facilitators over lecturers and team-based competition. Participants are selected based on proven motivation to build a durable post-sports career, demonstrated through a pre-program interview and selection process.
atg.curriculumText: Beyond The Game is a part-time, 6–9 month program that begins with a skills assessment to determine the best technical path for each individual. The curriculum combines industry-recognized certifications with wraparound support including professional communication and mental health resources to navigate the transition from athlete to tech professional.
atg.comptiaText: Participants earn industry-recognized CompTIA certifications through structured, hands-on courses taught twice a week. These credentials are trusted by employers and build the technical foundation for a career in tech. The first cohort has already completed the first two courses on the stack.
atg.comptiaCourse1Desc: Foundational computing, IT support, networking, cybersecurity, software development fundamentals, data management, and cloud technologies. Prepares participants to sit for the CompTIA Tech+ certification exam.
atg.comptiaCourse2Desc: Core networking concepts, protocols, security principles, and troubleshooting methodologies. Hands-on experience with networking hardware, topologies, and diagnostic tools. Prepares participants for the CompTIA Network+ certification exam.
atg.comptiaCourse3Desc: Threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, security operations, and governance. The third credential on the stack — and the gateway to SOC, GRC, and security-operations roles.
atg.resultsText: The first Beyond The Game cohort has completed its Tech+ and Network+ training, and the results are on the board. Security+ is underway right now.

resultsStats.label: certifications held by our program head

atg.resultsCard1Title: Kleon Penn passes CompTIA Tech+ on his first try
atg.resultsCard2Title: Ramon Clemente passed two IT certifications. He's not done.
atg.ecosystemText: We’re building a two-sided ecosystem, a value loop that delivers workforce-ready talent to employers while providing athletes with a clear roadmap to high-trajectory careers: upon completion of the program, participants will be placed in paid externships and apprenticeships with partner employers for 3–6 months.
atg.formDescription: Cohort 1 is in session right now. Join the waitlist to reserve your spot and be the first to know when enrollment for the next cohort opens.
atg.successMessage: We'll be in touch when enrollment opens.

codeAlong.poweredBy: POWERED BY BEYOND CODE COLLECTIVE · WITH SUPPORT FROM APPLE
codeAlong.description: Code Along is the free, video-based coding academy created by Beyond Code Collective, Black Girls Code, and GoldieBlox — real projects, built step by step, with hosts who code right alongside you. This season: build your own music playlist app with support from Apple.
codeAlong.episodesNote: Four episodes. One music playlist app, built from scratch. Episodes unlock here as they premiere — sign up below and we'll let you know the second they drop.
codeAlong.aboutText1: Code Along is exactly what it sounds like: you don't just watch someone code — you code along. Each episode walks through a real project step by step, at a pace made for first-time builders.
codeAlong.aboutText2: This season, hosts Destiney Williams and Daniel Ray turn a friendly rivalry over music taste into a coding challenge: building a music playlist app from scratch — with guest appearances from content creator Jalaiah Harmon and chemical engineer Dr. Fernanda Sulantay Vargas.
codeAlong.hostsText: Destiney Williams and Daniel Ray are creators from the same generation as the Code Along audience. They'll be writing every line of code with you — mistakes, debugging, wins and all.
codeAlong.poweredText: Code Along: Beyond is created and powered by Beyond Code Collective — keeping the series free and open for every young builder.

forge.description: The Forge is a network of intergenerational, site-specific hubs that blend technology education, community engagement, and workforce development under one roof. A true “third place” that is neither school nor work, where middle schoolers sit alongside mid-career professionals, and families with their kids, as they explore AI and emerging technology together.
forge.quoteText: At Beyond Code, we believe that everyone should have a role in shaping tomorrow’s technology. The Forge allows us to not only give people access to tools, but the community support and space to explore these tools, so they are empowered to confidently shape the future of technology and work.
forge.whatText: The Forge is designed to be a safe space to ask questions without fear or shame. Each The Forge center delivers culturally responsive programming to its community, serving K-12 students and adults seeking pathways into tech-driven careers.

pillars.title: Intergenerational
pillars.description: Middle schoolers alongside mid-career professionals and families. Every generation learns together.

pillars.title: Culturally Responsive
pillars.description: Designed in collaboration with local stakeholders. Programming shaped by and for the community it serves.

pillars.title: AI & Emerging Tech
pillars.description: Expanding opportunity in AI, data literacy, automation, and the technologies defining the future of work.

pillars.title: Free & Accessible
pillars.description: Free programming offered on a regular schedule. No barriers to entry, no prerequisites required.

programmingTypes.title: Lunch & Learn
programmingTypes.description: Open, one-time sessions on topics like AI, data literacy, and digital tools. No commitment required — just show up, learn, and connect.

programmingTypes.title: Cohort Programs
programmingTypes.description: Multi-week structured courses like AI Fundamentals. Limited seats, deeper learning, hands-on projects, and a dedicated instructor-led experience.

programmingTypes.title: Family Programming
programmingTypes.description: Caregivers and kids build real tech projects side by side. It's hands-on learning designed for the whole family — no experience required, just curiosity.

programmingTypes.title: High Schoolers
programmingTypes.description: Dedicated spaces where teens come to learn, build, and find their people. Whether it's a first project or a fifth, high schoolers leave with real skills and real connections.

forge.programmingNote: No preparation needed — you don’t need to bring a computer. Just come with an open mind and ready to learn.

team.heroDescription: Meet the leaders driving Beyond Code Collective’s mission to close the AI literacy gap and unlock digital opportunity for communities long excluded from the future of work.
team.founderBio: Cristina Mancini is the visionary Founder & CEO of Beyond Code Collective, a national ecosystem built to close the AI literacy gap and unlock digital dignity for communities long excluded from the future of work. She created BCC to answer a transformative question: What if every community had permanent, culturally grounded access to the skills and pathways that define the next decade of innovation?

leadershipBios.micaLeJohn: Over a decade of experience at the intersection of technology, creativity, and social impact. Formerly leading strategic partnerships and innovation at Black Girls Code.
leadershipBios.jihanJohnstonMcGlotten: Over a decade of experience building tech communities and driving access. Leading growth and expansion of The Forge in Atlanta.
leadershipBios.ramonClemente: Leading Beyond The Game, BCC's initiative connecting athletes with technology careers and digital skills for life beyond sports.

team.edQuote: Each member of the Tech Futures National Council brings a unique background and perspective, and we are proud to welcome such a distinguished group to the Beyond Code community. Their extensive experience will be instrumental in shaping our ecosystem and ensuring that our programming translates into real-world impact.
team.councilDescription: Beyond Code Collective has formed its Tech Futures National Council — a distinguished group of technologists, academics, and business leaders providing strategic insight and real-world perspectives to inform curricula and programming. Council members share a commitment to building a future where under-resourced learners not only access emerging technologies, but also shape them.
team.founderQuote: I founded Beyond Code Collective because innovation must include everyone and technology should be a bridge to opportunity, not a barrier. I am thrilled to bring together a team that shares this vision. The leadership team reflects the expertise, passion, and commitment required to advance our mission. Together, we’re not just focused on closing the digital divide but ensuring communities aren’t left behind.

hero.body: The workforce is changing. Catalyst develops the talent to match — an 8–12 week, cohort-based workforce program for adult learners ready to move into tech. No prior tech background required. You bring the drive; we bring the curriculum, the community, and the connections to real employers.

gap.label: The Gap
gap.body: Employers are reorganizing roles around AI faster than training systems can adapt. Over 70% of mid-skill roles now require digital or AI fluency, and 39% of core skills will be outdated by 2030. Meanwhile, 1 in 4 adult learners cite cost and childcare as their top barriers to retraining. Catalyst is the bridge: a structured, measurable workforce program designed with employers and credentialing bodies, built around the realities of adult learners' lives.

cells.title: 8–12 Week Core
cells.text: A cohort structure that respects adult learners' realities — jobs, families, and everything in between — without lowering the outcome.

cells.title: Stackable Micro-Certifications
cells.text: Industry-recognized credentials that compound as careers evolve. Proof that stacks, not a single bootcamp certificate.

cells.title: Employer-Aligned Curriculum
cells.text: Curriculum defined with partners around the roles they're actually filling, not the credentials of five years ago.

cells.title: Wraparound Support
cells.text: Durable-skills coaching in communication, reliability, and follow-through, plus a community that stays engaged after the program ends.

items.title: Placement
items.text: Built-in connections to employers, interview prep, externship opportunities, and warm introductions across our hiring network open doors as you launch your search.

items.title: Build & Practice
items.text: Project-based learning with mentor reviews, a structured build sprint, and a showcase day to put real work in front of real audiences.

items.title: Entrepreneurship
items.text: Business setup, client acquisition, and pricing fundamentals for self-directed builders taking AI implementation to small businesses.

workshops.label: Upcoming Workshops + Labs
workshops.body: Low-stakes entry points into the Catalyst world. Drop into a session, build a habit, meet the community. Sign up individually — no application needed.

cards.title: Home For Summer
cards.text: Our summer workshop series: a low-stakes introduction to the emerging tech tools and ideas shaping the market. Working title — final name and schedule to come.

cards.title: MASS
cards.lead: Your tech skills get you qualified. Networking gets you in the door. And your story gets you the offer.
cards.text: MASS is an eight-week coaching program that builds the part of your career no tech bootcamp alone covers: how to confidently tell your story, network without cringing, advocate for yourself, and ask for what you're worth. Real practice, live, every week. No filler.

facilitator.name: Angel Aviles
facilitator.bio: Actress, turned tech marketing strategist, turned award-winning coach. A bestselling author who has coached thousands and built MASS because she has lived the exact gap you're standing in.

cards.title: Virtual Labs
cards.text: Hands-on virtual lab sessions built with our partners, where you build with emerging tech alongside facilitators and your peers. Program name and dates announcing soon.
